title: Ok, but not blown away
text: My 5 year old thought this was ok.  However it didn't hold his interest for a really long time.  Some of the things sent were pretty cheap or didn't fit where they were supposed to.  The bug to go in the fossil clay didn't leave impressions it was so flimsy and the starfish didn't even fit in the cup.  Not sure I will keep the subscription.  He did like the circuit.
label: neutral
